newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close mixed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close mixed in light trade.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed mixed in light trade as investors turned to other markets, traders said.
The bolsa's index slipped 0.33 percent to close at 5,988.04 points as 13 stocks rose, 16 fell and 12 closed flat.
"The market looks fairly fully priced, at least for this year," one visiting British fund manager told Reuters.
Trade was lead by Fondo de Valores Inomobilarios at 8.6 million shares, and Corimon B shares, at 5.3 million shares, as a total 23.7 million exchanged hands worth 2.7 billion bolivars ($5.7 million).
Among widely held stocks, telephone company CANTV closed down 11.50 bolivars at 1818.50 bolivars, Electricidad de Caracas closed off 1.00 bolivar at 501.00 and Corimon B closed flat at 7.50 bolivars.
